subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Nina took this subject on her first day at a new school.”?
options: Then our teacher told us that loud sounds made Eric feel pain.
Nina arrived at school late, but her teacher did not scold her.
This year, a new art teacher, Ms. Park, kept the door open after school.
They learned that she arrived at school earlier than most teachers and knew which classrooms were always neat or messy.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Then our teacher told us that loud sounds made Eric feel pain.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Nina arrived at school late, but her teacher did not scold her.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「This year, a new art teacher, Ms. Park, kept the door open after school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They learned that she arrived at school earlier than most teachers and knew which classrooms were always neat…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Nina arrived at school late, but her teacher did not scold her.」，答案為「Nina arrived at school late, but her teacher did not scold her.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Nina arrived at school late, but her teacher did not scold her.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
